final_stage_task.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the C-R2-01-control reviser stage. The exact frozen Goal was activated, the binding guard passed, and that same Goal was completed.

- [final.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/reviser/final.md)
- [source-map.json](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/reviser/source-map.json) and [source index](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/reviser/sources/INDEX.md)
- [Activation receipt](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/reviser/native-goal-activation.json), [completion receipt](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/reviser/native-goal-completion.json), and [guard result](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/C-R2-01/control/stages/reviser/goal-binding-guard.txt)

The revision adds sleeve strata to the coupon design and treats 12 weeks only as a planning cap, with an inconclusive outcome when evidence is insufficient. It preserves uncertainty about the investigator’s 60-minute timing and corrects the description of S01’s laboratory sheets. Those limits are consistent with the primary paper, model-ink study, and CCI seasonal-monitoring guidance ([S01](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10570-023-05626-6), [S02](https://tugraz.elsevierpure.com/ws/portalfiles/portal/79063769/1-s2.0-S0264127523010092-main.pdf), [CCI](https://www.canada.ca/en/conservation-institute/services/agents-deterioration/humidity.html)).

No specimen inspection or material-performance validation was performed. The Goal completed with 118,942 tokens used and 581 seconds elapsed.
